matchupOfTheWeek.title: Run Defense vs. Rush Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our run defense grades 23/100 (below average) against LV's rush offense at 3/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing: Las Vegas brings a pass rush graded 84/100 that will absolutely terrorize our 39/100 pass protection, and their pass defense at 90/100 is nearly elite—which spells disaster for our 29/100 passing attack. But there's a silver lining so obvious it's gleaming: their rush offense grades out at a truly catastrophic 3/100, and we're sitting at 23/100 on run defense, which means we're the lesser evil in what amounts to the week's biggest mismatch. The Raiders have outpaced us slightly in recent form (0.09 EPA/play to our flat 0.00), and we're favored by 3.5 at home for a reason—but we need to lean hard on the ground game and trust our secondary (87/100) to keep us in this thing, because letting Las Vegas beat us through the air would be almost unforgivable given how bad their running game actually is.
